name: manual_93a795
claim: Base64-encode binary archive bundles (.zip) before sending via lan_peer_assign drop: HTTP portal endpoints read request bodies as UTF-8 text and corrupt raw binary archives.

decisions.notes: Direct file drops of binary zip archives across HTTP portal drop endpoints failed with UTF-8 decoding errors. Base64 encoding with companion cover markdown and dual SHA-256 hashes ensures lossless transport across heterogeneous Mac and Windows fleets.

rationale: Direct file drops of binary zip archives across HTTP portal drop endpoints failed with UTF-8 decoding errors. Base64 encoding with companion cover markdown and dual SHA-256 hashes ensures lossless transport across heterogeneous Mac and Windows fleets.
